tagline.en_US: RetroArch is a frontend for emulators, game engines, and media players.

description.en_US: RetroArch is a frontend for emulators, game engines, and media players. It enables users to run classic video games across a wide variety of systems through a single graphical interface. The platform centralizes game controls, settings, and emulation cores into a unified experience.

tips: Copy and paste between your computer and the streamed desktop, including images, works over HTTPS: port 3001 or an HTTPS reverse proxy. Browsers block clipboard access over plain HTTP.
